purpose: Twenty-sixth-pass bounded parallel live official and first-party verification for four current-centre-operation, tenant-control, multi-unit-occupation and exact-store-location rows while the same V53 task remains pickup-timeout claimable. No second task, runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Primary auction pages, current first-party centre/operator pages, Companies House and official council planning routes are promoted. Search-index or directory evidence does not prove lease continuation, legal completion, exact demise or parcel identity.
method.conflict_policy: Current official company and first-party activity signals may confirm identity or business-park use but do not establish occupancy rights. Conflicting or missing exact-location evidence remains open.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.

rows.address: Idlewells Shopping Centre, Market Street, Sutton-in-Ashfield, Nottinghamshire, NG17 1BP
rows.resolved_fact: The Acuitus record identifies the long-leasehold shopping-centre investment but its Withdrawn Post status is historical. Idlewells' current first-party pages publish centre management at NG17 1BP, current daily opening times, access and parking information, and an extensive live town-centre directory covering retail, food, services, charity and leisure operators. These routes strongly reconfirm an operating centre and active public-facing tenant mix. They do not supply a complete dated rent roll, vacancy schedule, lease expiries, current NOI, sale completion or the exact long-lease title geometry.

rows.address: 139-145 Lichfield Street, Walsall, West Midlands, WS1 1SE
rows.resolved_fact: Starting Point Recruitment Limited remains active at the exact 139-145 Lichfield Street address, has accounts to 31 March 2025 and a current registered charge. Companies House shows 145 Holdings Limited as its active person with significant control from July 2024; 145 Holdings is active at the same exact address. Steps To Work ceased controlling Starting Point on 27 July 2024 and entered creditors' voluntary liquidation on 28 October 2024. The current operating tenant and control structure are therefore separated from the liquidating former guarantor/control entity. The auction guarantee, executed lease, any replacement security and insolvency effect remain unread.

rows.address: David Ethan House / London Group Business Park, 715 North Circular Road, London, NW2 7AH and NW2 7AQ
rows.resolved_fact: Current Companies House routes identify active property, motor, service, stone, equipment and digital businesses across Units A, F, 1, 5, 10 and 1C at 715 North Circular Road, using both NW2 7AH and NW2 7AQ. L G Property Investments, Lake View Investments, North Circular Autos, A&A Car Service and Car City Care have current active records; several other exact-site entities have overdue statements, overdue accounts or strike-off proposals. Brent's planning register remains searchable by address and postcode. The evidence strongly reconfirms a current multi-unit business park, but it does not allocate the David Ethan House demise, prove each company's physical occupation, reconcile the postcode variants or establish the exact freehold boundary.

rows.address: 10 Central Road, Leeds, West Yorkshire, LS1 6DE
rows.resolved_fact: Acuitus identifies the exact 10 Central Road unit, a ten-year lease from 1 January 2025 and an individual trading as Out of This World. The current Out of This World/Vegan World first-party site remains operational, describes a Leeds store trading since 2005 and identifies DLT (Organics) Ltd, company 06561791, as the website operator. However, the read first-party pages still do not publish 10 Central Road as the current store address, and the direct current Companies House and exact Leeds planning-case readbacks were not obtained in this pass. Brand and legal-entity continuity are strengthened, but exact subject occupation, assignment or lease continuation remain unpromoted.
